name: Browser Downloads
location: Chrome/Edge: History.downloads table in the profile folder; Firefox: downloads recorded via moz_annos in places.sqlite (or separate downloads.sqlite on older versions)
purpose: Modern browsers include a built-in download manager capable of keeping a history of every file downloaded by the user, providing information about websites visited and corresponding items retrieved.
normal_baseline: Downloads correspond to work-related documents/installers from known sources.
anomalies: Download from a known malicious-tool distribution site or file-sharing service immediately preceding execution evidence for the same file
A download recorded as failed/incomplete that nonetheless has execution evidence, suggesting the file was retrieved through another channel and the browser record was only partial
anti_forensic_notes: Downloads table entries can be cleared alongside general history clearing; the downloaded file itself, if kept, will separately carry Zone.Identifier MOTW evidence of its origin.
interpretation: This entry is downloads specifically; the browser's separate crash-recovery tab/window state is its own dedicated `session-restore` artifact, not part of this one. The two used to be combined here but were split to match the poster's own separate boxes.
